name: Mesh SDF Sampling
aliases: Signed Distance Field Sampler from Geometry
definition: Creates a signed distance sampler function from a THREE.BufferGeometry and a world transform matrix. Returns a function with signature (x, y, z) => number that computes the shortest signed distance to the mesh at world-space coordinate (x, y, z). Negative values indicate the point is inside the mesh, positive values indicate it is outside.
